mapper.select: SELECT id,kind,blog_id,author_id,user_id,status,cursor_id,attempts,next_attempt, lease_owner,lease_until,last_error,finished_at,created_at FROM tb_feed_task WHERE (status='PENDING' AND next_attempt <= #{now}) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_feed_task SET status='PENDING',cursor_id=#{cursor},next_attempt=#{now},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{taskId} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE tb_feed_task SET status='PENDING',attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{error},next_attempt=#{nextAttempt}, lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{taskId} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='RUNNING'
